Personality: Agelaos, a prominent figure of the Naupaktioi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Agelaos owes allegiance to the Aetolian League, hailing from the noble house of Naupaktioi. Historical Record: Agelaos of Naupaktos, a wise Aetolian statesman who warns that while the Greeks fight among themselves a cloud is gathering in the west, and urges them to make peace before Rome or Carthage comes to Greece. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
